item.title: Trump denies any plan to replace chief of staff Susie Wiles

item.title: Journalists Casually Smear School-Choice Supporters — Because They've Never Met Any
item.description: There ought to be a rule: Anyone wishing to work in major-league news media must first spend a semester abroad in the Midwest.

item.title: Xi's Invitation to American Students Comes with Dangerous Strings Attached
item.description: Those who accept it will feel compelled to install WeChat — and Beijing gets to keep the data.
